header.title: Experience
header.sub: Around five years in banking technology: from building a loan origination system as an engineer to owning the AI roadmap for one as a product manager.

timeline.title: Senior Product Manager — Loan Origination System & AI
timeline.company: Care Analytics and Advisory Pvt. Ltd. (CareEdge Group) · India
bullets: Own the AI product roadmap for the lending platform: identifying credit and operations workflows where AI removes manual effort, defining requirements with credit and risk stakeholders, and sequencing the build.

Designed and launched four AI capabilities into live lending workflows (CAM Automation, Bank Statement Analyzer, Financial Statement Reader, Document Analyzer), each with PII-risk handling built into the data flow.
Architected an end-to-end straight-through-processing journey for existing-to-bank customers across multiple product nuances, targeting a 90% TAT reduction.
Leading a USD 1M+ engagement end-to-end: requirements gathering, solution architecture and Agile delivery.

timeline.title: Product Manager — Loan Origination System
timeline.company: Care Analytics and Advisory Pvt. Ltd. (CareEdge Group) · India
bullets: Integrated the platform's first AI components into production lending workflows: CAM automation, AI BSA for automated financial spreading and borrower analysis, and an AI chatbot for natural-language querying of loan data and policy guidelines.

Closed a USD 1M+ deal end-to-end, independently leading proposal authoring, product demos, stakeholder meetings and onsite presentations to client leadership through to signed contract. The largest single deal won in this tenure.
Led a team of 5 across 5 concurrent end-to-end LOS implementations for global clients valued at USD 1M+, owning scope, budget and timelines to achieve on-time go-lives.
Architected a Report Generator module with API integrations, model formulation and parameterisation to automate MSME credit underwriting workflows.
Spearheaded standardisation and a UX revamp of the LOS through continuous user research and workshops, targeting 20% TAT reduction and 30% faster implementations.
Ideated and formulated a Loan Collections module for a global client and converted the idea to a signed deal within two months.
Authored 15+ proposals across LOS, Mobile LOS, Collections and Collateral Management, representing a USD 7M+ pipeline.
Led pre-sales discovery workshops with CXOs and functional heads across India, Bhutan and Sri Lanka, drafting customised credit appraisal transformation solutions.
Delivered UI/UX upgrades targeting 15% faster loan decision turnaround and upgraded the digital onboarding channel to cut clicks-to-complete by 30%.
Delivered training, hyper-care and handover artefacts (FSDs, SOPs, user manuals, video walkthroughs) enabling over 95% task self-service by client operations teams within 30 days of go-live.

timeline.title: Senior Software Engineer
timeline.company: Nucleus Software Exports Ltd. · FinnOne Neo · India
bullets: Built and enhanced FinnOne Neo, Nucleus' customer acquisition system covering the full lending lifecycle from lead generation to disbursement, for a Middle Eastern banking client.
Led 5 engineers through Agile delivery of 10+ major product customisations aligned to banking requirements.
Built a digital parsing solution for loan application migration between data formats (95% faster) and a script migration tool that cut data migration from one day to ten minutes.
Automated code debugging through a custom UI tool, cutting development time 90%; transformed the code-review system impacting 1,000+ employees.
Architected a three-tier environment structure (Local, Smoke, Quality), reducing performance defects 70%; standardised development templates cut developer idle time 90%.
Presented product insights and customisation proposals to CXO-level stakeholders at cross-border banking clients.

timeline.title: AI Product Management Intern
bullets: Defined the IT vision for a debt collection product, built the product architecture to enhance UX, and designed a data enrichment engine that improved decision accuracy.

timeline.title: Developer Intern
bullets: Built a business portal to digitise customer order processing, targeting an 80% reduction in order processing time.
